title: Geonosis Patrol Fighter
text:
Exploit 2 (While playing this card, defeat up to 2 units you control. This card costs 2 resources less for each unit defeated this way.)
When Played: You may return a non-leader unit that costs 3 or less to its owner's hand.
rules:
Abilities that refer to a card's cost always refer to its printed cost, regardless of modifiers.
Abilities that return a card to hand must choose a card in play unless otherwise specified.
